intro: If you have a concert, trade fair or exhibition at IMPACT Muang Thong Thani and want a bed nearby without paying Novotel or ibis prices — Botanic Service Room at Impact Muang Thong Thani is the lowest-priced option in this cluster · It's a 53-room, SHA-certified 3-star serviced apartment on Chaengwattana Road in Pak Kret, Nonthaburi, sitting roughly 1.5 km from the IMPACT halls — a 10-15 minute walk or a 3-minute ride · The property runs a complimentary shuttle within a 10 km radius, gives free parking, free Wi-Fi and has a surprisingly pleasant garden · Real guest scores sit around 8.7, which reflects good value for the price · Rooms start from approx. ฿900/night in low season.

body.html: Botanic Service Room at Impact Muang Thong Thani sits on Soi Leabklongprapa off Chaengwattana Road in Pak Kret, Nonthaburi — one of the access roads that runs parallel to the Muang Thong Thani development · With 53 rooms and SHA certification, all rooms are air-conditioned and fitted with hardwood floors, a flat-screen TV, fridge, tea/coffee maker and a private bathroom with shower · What makes this place stand out in the IMPACT hotel cluster is price: from approx. ฿900 per night in low season, it is the most affordable option in any set that includes ibis and Novotel Bangkok IMPACT · The walk to IMPACT Arena and Challenger Hall is roughly 1.5 km — about 10-15 minutes on foot or 3 minutes by car or shuttle.

Room types run from the Standard Twin Room (two single beds, around 21 sqm) and a Premium Studio (double bed with sitting area) up to the One Bedroom Suite (double plus sofa bed, good for a family or three people) and a Quadruple Room (double plus two singles) · Rooms are compact but functional — not the place to spend a long lazy afternoon, but more than fine for a one-night concert stay · Guests consistently flag the cleanliness and the genuinely helpful staff: one reviewer checked in past midnight and still found the team friendly and efficient · The one area to flag in advance: walls are thinner than at ibis or Novotel, and rooms on the street side can pick up noise from the nearby restaurants and bars in the evening.

"Room was super clean and fresh, AC cold, staff incredibly nice even checking in past midnight · Free shuttle to IMPACT and free parking — best budget option for a concert night in Muang Thong Thani."

On facilities, the property punches above its price point · The free shuttle within a 10 km radius is the headline perk: it covers IMPACT Arena and both Challenger Halls, so guests heading to an early event or wanting a ride back after a late show have a no-cost option · Beyond that there's free parking (generous for the area), free Wi-Fi throughout, a 24-hour front desk, laundry, luggage storage and an on-site restaurant · Some rooms have a private balcony or garden-side patio — unusual at this price — which gives the place a bit more air than a standard budget hotel box · Know before you book: there's no swimming pool, and breakfast is charged separately · If you want a pool and full-service breakfast, Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is the right answer, at a considerably higher rate.

Be honest with yourself about the location · The hotel sits in the Chaengwattana–Pak Kret corridor, not inside Muang Thong Thani itself, so the walk to the IMPACT halls runs along a regular road rather than a climate-controlled skybridge · If you want a covered walkway direct from room to hall, ibis Bangkok IMPACT has exactly that · The Pink Line MRT extension opened in 2025 and now serves the area: Muang Thong Thani station (MT01) has a direct skybridge into IMPACT and sits roughly 1.15 km from the hotel — walkable or reachable by the hotel shuttle · Don Muang Airport is about 8 km away (around 15 minutes by road), and central Bangkok is 30-40 minutes depending on traffic · For drivers, the free parking is a genuine draw; Grab and Bolt are reliable alternatives if you're not driving.

Straight talk: Botanic Service Room at Impact is the right choice if your only goal is a clean, comfortable bed for the lowest possible price on a concert or event night at IMPACT · Free shuttle, free parking, genuinely clean rooms and friendly staff are all real — not marketing copy · The trade-offs are thinner walls than the big-chain options, a 10-15 minute walk rather than a skywalk, and shuttle hours that aren't round-the-clock · If you need more comfort, ibis Bangkok IMPACT sits at the next price tier up and connects to the halls via skywalk · If you want a pool, spa and full buffet, Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is the full-service answer at a much higher price.

Practical tips from tracking the reviews here: book early when dates land on a major IMPACT event — this is a 53-room property and it fills fast during motor shows, concerts and large fairs, with rates jumping significantly · Ask for a garden-side room when you check in to avoid the street-side noise · Check the shuttle schedule before you arrive, especially if the show ends late — if the last shuttle has run, Grab is typically a ฿50-80 fare for the 3-minute ride · Compare Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com prices before booking, as platform rates diverge noticeably around event windows.

faqTitle: FAQ — Botanic Service Room at Impact Muang Thong Thani, Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Botanic Service Room and how far is it from IMPACT Arena?
faq.a: The hotel is at 37/74-75 Soi Leabklongprapa, Chaengwattana Road, Khlong Kluea, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi, about 1.5 km from IMPACT Arena and Challenger Hall — a 10-15 minute walk or 3-minute drive · The hotel runs a free shuttle covering a 10 km radius · The Pink Line MRT Muang Thong Thani station (MT01), which connects directly to IMPACT via skybridge, is about 1.15 km away · Don Muang Airport is roughly 8 km (about 15 minutes by road).

faq.q: What is the starting price at Botanic Service Room and what room types are available?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. ฿900/night for a Standard Twin Room in low season · The property also offers a Premium Studio (double bed), One Bedroom Suite (double plus sofa bed, ideal for three) and a Quadruple Room (double plus two singles) · During major IMPACT events rates can double and the 53 rooms fill quickly, so book early and compare platforms.

faq.q: Does Botanic Service Room have a free shuttle to IMPACT Arena?
faq.a: Yes — the hotel runs a complimentary shuttle within a 10 km radius, which covers both IMPACT Arena and Challenger Hall · However, it runs on a timetable rather than around the clock, so call ahead if your event finishes late · If the last shuttle has run, Grab or Bolt typically charges ฿50-80 for the 3-minute trip.

faq.q: How does Botanic Service Room compare with ibis Bangkok IMPACT?
faq.a: Botanic Service Room is typically ฿300-600 per night cheaper than ibis Bangkok IMPACT and has a garden, free parking and free shuttle · ibis has a covered Skywalk that leads directly to the IMPACT halls without going outside, and better wall insulation · Choose Botanic for the lowest price; choose ibis if the skywalk convenience and quieter rooms matter more · For a full-service experience with a pool and spa, Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is the step up.

faq.q: Can I get to IMPACT using the Pink Line MRT from this hotel?
faq.a: Yes. The Pink Line MRT extension opened in 2025 and includes Muang Thong Thani station (code MT01), which connects via skybridge directly into the IMPACT complex · The station is about 1.15 km from Botanic Service Room — you can walk it in around 15 minutes or use the hotel's free shuttle to reach the station · This is now a viable car-free option for reaching IMPACT from the hotel.
